_README: Example Elicitation hook block for an overnight run. First copy the hook: `cp examples/claude-code-overnight/hooks/elicitation_evalopt_overnight.py ~/.claude/hooks/` (or another location; adjust the command paths below). Then merge this block into ~/.claude/settings.json with the example installer (union/append, backs up first): `python examples/claude-code-overnight/apply_overnight_permissions.py --block examples/claude-code-overnight/elicitation-overnight.block.json --apply`. Auto-declines MCP elicitation during overnight runs so unattended runs never pause; no-op interactively.
